title: About Us
headline: KASAMAN — Modern Electrical and Automation Solutions
intro: Every component in an electrical system has a role to play. At KASAMAN, we help bring these components together in a solution that meets the needs of your home, business or industrial facility, from equipment selection to installation and commissioning.
reliability_text: We work only with verified suppliers and guarantee the quality of the products.
honesty_text: Communication with each customer is built on trust and transparency.
responsibility_text: Our team ensures that you receive the right product at the right time.
work: Our work covers residential and industrial electrical installation, electrical panel assembly and automation. We focus on the practical side of a system: how it will work, how convenient it will be to operate and how it can be maintained in the future.
himel: KASAMAN is an official representative of HIMEL. Our online store offers equipment and components for electrical protection, control and power supply. We help you navigate the range and choose the option that suits your needs.
approach: You can turn to us for help selecting a single component or delivering an entire project. We discuss your needs in clear language, turning technical requirements into practical steps.
cta: Tell us about your project. Together, we’ll find the right solution.
